test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ajay is driving in the east direction and covers a distance of 2.5 km and then takes a turn in the left direction and travels a distance of 3 km. Further, he turns to the right and travels a distance of 4.5 km. Lastly, he turns to his right and travels a distance of 3 km. How far is he form the starting point? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Ajay is driving in the east direction and covers a distance of 2.5 km and then takes a turn in the left direction and travels a distance of 3 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da4b03a2b9d424a7d7ad9fffccb32348a074574a7130f20251a14dfa0a5b8cc8.png] 

Step 2: Further, he turns to the right and travels a distance of 4.5 km. Lastly, he turns to his right and travels a distance of 3 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f952c62275669581c5b754d84c1b084845b2427ea6b57dcfce42534d8f0c21.png] 

Total distance = **2.5 + 4.5 = 7 km**

**Hence the correct answer is option 3)**
